presentation.label: RHYTHMIC FILTER
presentation.summary: Euclidean rhythms for filters and amplitude.
presentation.overview: Euclidean rhythms drive filter cutoff or amplitude. Set the number of steps and pulses, rotate the pattern, and shape each movement with the envelope controls. Euclid automatically follows the swing amount and selected swing steps of its audio track, including changes made with SWING ALL.
highlights: LP, BP, HP, notch and amplitude modes
Follows track swing, including SWING ALL
usage: Set STEPS for the pattern length and PULSE for the number of evenly distributed events.
ROT rotates the rhythm and RATE sets its time grid. TYPE selects low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, notch or amplitude modulation.
FREQ sets the base cutoff, DEPTH controls movement and DEC / LEN shapes each event. AMP mode relabels these controls for level and amount.
Euclid automatically follows the swing amount and selected swing steps of its audio track, including changes made with SWING ALL.

Select the track, enter Grid Recording with REC, then open TRACK TRIG EDIT with FUNC+BANK and select SWING. Turn LEVEL for this track or hold FUNC while turning LEVEL for all tracks; 50% is straight timing.

controls.name: FREQ
controls.doc: Base filter cutoff or AMP level; cutoff is 30 Hz..15 kHz logarithmic

controls.name: DEPTH
controls.doc: Cutoff or gain modulation: negative/down, zero/static, positive/up

controls.name: DECAY
controls.doc: Envelope decay up to eight steps / gate length; inert for random

controls.name: STEPS
controls.doc: Euclidean cycle length 1..64 (stored as length minus one)

controls.name: PULSE
controls.doc: Pulse count; values above STEPS are clamped to STEPS

controls.name: ROT
controls.doc: Shift rhythm and captured values right, modulo STEPS

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: Division relative to the track speed; 1/16 = one track step

controls.name: TYPE
controls.doc: Two-pole low/high/band/notch filter response, or amplitude modulation

controls.name: ATK
controls.doc: Attack / gate edge / random slew, 0..one step

controls.name: OUT
controls.doc: Pulse envelope, timed gate, random sample-and-hold, captured random

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: follow the track swing
steps: Select the audio track with its TRACK key, hold FUNC and press FX1 or FX2, then select Euclid with LEVEL and confirm with YES.
Press the same FX key to return to the main page. Set STEPS to 16 and PULSE to 5; in SETUP, keep RATE at 1/16 and OUT at ENV.
Press REC to enter Grid Recording, then hold FUNC and press BANK to open TRACK TRIG EDIT. Select SWING with UP/DOWN and turn LEVEL to set the track swing amount; 50% is straight timing.
For an all-track change, hold FUNC while turning LEVEL on the SWING row. SWING ALL changes every track's amount; Euclid follows the amount and swing steps of the track it occupies.

Press NO to close the menu and REC to leave Grid Recording. Start playback on a track with audible audio: Euclid's pulses follow its track swing grid. Press STOP to return to the base cutoff or gain, or set MIX to 0 for dry audio.

access.location: Audio track FX1 or FX2 SETUP: Euclid in the effect chooser. These captures use FX2.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 or FX2 to open that effect slot's SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to Euclid and press YES to assign it.
Press the same FX key to close SETUP for FREQ, RES, DEPTH, DEC, STEPS and PULSE.
Hold FUNC and press that FX key again for ROT, RATE, TYPE, ATK, output mode and MIX. Labels change with TYPE and output mode.
